text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The necessary number of members for the 
Aoharu Cup were assembled. At first, the 
members got along well while training, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worrying too much about the other
members, 
she found herself unable to say what she 
really wanted to say,
and things gradually 
grew awkward between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile,
Team First was steadily growing 
stronger under strict management,
boasting 
perfect trust within the team...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer began to worry whether they 
could keep winning through the Aoharu Cup 
at this rate.
